## 2026-10-01 01:40 UTC — [Pillar 1] Matched short-to-long flips widen BTC net long, but the cadence and expectancy gates fail

**Task and fresh source:** Collected fixed-universe HL leaderboard top-20 at **01:38:49 UTC**, **20/20 accounts fetched**, zero failures. BTC **4L/3S**, **$46.348M long / $13.608M short / +$32.739M net**; ETH **1L/5S**, SOL **0L/7S**. The prior gap is **257.94 minutes**, beyond the 120-minute cadence limit. Aggregate BTC net change **+$12.670M** reconciles to **+$17.939M matched-wallet signed change** and **−$5.269M membership effect** from Auros exiting the leaderboard; one entrant has no BTC leg. Membership change is composition, not a trade, and matched differences across this gap are not timely flow. ecb6 flipped from **$7.027M short to $6.108M long** (**+$13.135M signed change**); f5d8 flipped from **$0.963M short to $1.141M long** (**+$2.104M**). fc27 added **$1.688M long** and Machi added **$1.172M long**. Absolute shorts fell **$7.829M**, so this is not bearish short accumulation.

**Breadth and expectancy:** Shorts total **$13.608M**, but only **two material sources** and effective breadth **1.989**; ccf3 controls **59.71%**. Machi controls **70.51%** of long notional. Excluding Machi leaves adjusted BTC net just **+$0.059M**; the full-universe long direction is concentration-sensitive. Two ≥20%-share shorts persist, but the structured bearish audit exits nonzero because `btc_net_short=false`; bearish candidate/persistence and cadence-valid absolute-add confirmation are false. Cross-asset short counts are snapshot context, not forward evidence. Anchor derisk streak is **1**. Source-persistence weighting lowers forward accuracy **1.27 pp** and stability **18.57%**; walk-forward hit weighting lowers accuracy **0.46 pp** despite a **10.02%** stability gain. Neither is promoted. No discrete event clears the date-bootstrap gate. The registered forward ledger validates but has only **three observations on three dates, 0/3 positive, −0.373163% mean**, bootstrap **[−0.490272%, −0.232015%]**.
